svg.desc:
==================================================================================== GOOD GOBLIN - mascot, three poses. Hand-authored SVG. No scripts, no external assets, no CSS vars, no animation. ====================================================================================
Every pose is authored around the DIE CENTRE (0,0) and fitted to die-art.svg's real hull: circumradius 80, verts (0,-80) (69.28,-40) (69.28,40) (0,80) (-69.28,40) (-69.28,-40). Every grip sits on that hull, not on a stand-in.
Each pose is one group with two sibling children: #gob-*-back body. Draw BELOW the die. #gob-*-front the gripping hands plus the shadows they cast ON the die. Draw ABOVE the die.
LIGHT: one warm torch pool below the die, the same source the die is painted for. Warm values live on jaw, chin, chest flanks, forearms and fingertips - never on chest the die occludes. Cool blue-grey ambient above. Darkest values fall into the die's blue-black shadow family (#26302f / #232c2d); green survives only in the midtones, so goblin and stone share one shadow family.
SURFACE: every plane carries a turbulence grain pass (gobGrainMottle / gobGrainFine, same recipe as the die's) plus hard brush-edged patches, so no transition is a bare Gaussian ramp.
INK: outermost contour 5.8 (the die's pen is 6.2) then arm 4.8, ear 4.4, brow 4.2 tapering to 2.6, interior detail 2.2-3.2. Contours wobble and thin warm where the torch eats them.
THE TURN: the die half-turns by mirroring about y=0, so the rotation axis has to run through the goblin's two fists. Both fists therefore sit on the hull's widest points, (-69.28, 0) and (69.28, 0), and the arms crank about the shoulders. ====================================================================================
